invariants: MtpDraftExtend retains slot/position/argument validation and mainline cleanup ownership; only a host-known uniform multi-slot batch with T>4 supplies the slot.
Score keys only feed existing single-shot/streaming BF16 GEMM; pooled KV/index writes, page tables and RoPE addressing still use original d_seq_id.
Existing ValidSequenceCapacities and min_slot_capacity constrain padded score reads; no new memory allocation or workspace-size change.
Default arguments preserve single-slot, mixed-slot and T<=4 dispatch. Full/subset heads share the same dispatch contract.
No tokenizer, template, output parser, tool control, grammar, cache algorithm, scheduler, quota or cancellation source changed.
No prefill timers, snapshot preallocation/write pipeline, shared-host offload or unaccepted client content extracted.
arithmetic: BF16 GEMM intermediate rounding is not bitwise SIMT FP32; independent sliced reference and representative state tests plus full-model HTTP required.
